text: APPROVE. The refactor moves each branch of `Read` into a small helper (`StartTopLevel`, `ReadNested`, `ReadImporterLine`, `ReadPackageLine`) that keeps the original control flow, conditions and `i + 1` line number, so behaviour is unchanged. Every method is now well under 15 in complexity (the largest, `ReadPackageLine`, is around 5), and nothing in the nullable flow or the new private nested `ReadState` should introduce a warning. I did not build or run it, so the build and behaviour judgments come from reading the diff alone.
